notes: CBER letter to R3 Medical Companies' co-located Bello (manufacturer) and Regen (private-label distributor) facilities: umbilical-cord/cord-blood HCT/P products (ReBellaWJ, ReBellaXO, ReBellaXOL, ReBellaCB, and Bello's own-labeled BelloWJ/BelloXO/BelloXOL, plus ReBellaXOL's alternate label ReBellaGF) fail the homologous-use HCT/P exception and are charged as unapproved new drugs / unlicensed biologics, with CGMP sterile/aseptic-processing violations (unvalidated aseptic processes, sterility-test samples frozen/thawed before testing). contamination_present is false: the letter describes validation and testing-methodology deficiencies (e.g., freeze-thaw before sterility testing that could mask contamination) rather than a documented finding of actual product contamination. recall_concern is true because FDA presses for a disposition plan for undistributed inventory and for previously distributed, still-within-expiry product made under the violative conditions.
